changelog.title: What's New in 7.3.0
items: Theme Maker — create your own themes with live preview, your name as author, and a description; save them to the Community section or export the .json to publish
Theme Shop now separates Official SteamLite Themes from Community Themes (published to GitHub + themes you create)
Theme Shop refresh button to reload the catalog
Community themes from the SteamLite GitHub repository are supported again
UI Editor (SUE) removed — replaced by the Theme Maker
New achievement: Theme Author (create your first theme)
2 new free themes: Neon Noir, Glacier Mint

news.title: SteamLite 7.3.0 — Theme Maker & Community Themes
news.content: Version 7.3.0 turns everyone into a theme designer: the new Theme Maker lets you pick every color, write custom CSS, preview live, and save themes under your own author name with a description. The Theme Shop now splits Official SteamLite Themes from Community Themes — anything published to the SteamLite GitHub repo appears there automatically, plus everything you create, with export to share. Also includes a shop refresh button, the new Theme Author achievement, and 2 new free themes (Neon Noir, Glacier Mint).

news.title: Scheduled Engine Change
news.content: Steamlite has a scheduled downtime and will be unavailable between 27/08/2026 - 30/08/2026. during this time github services will be unavailable and any new themes, news and comunity updates wont be there. we are looking forward to releasing 8.0.0 and if you are intrested, please contact either an admin or Castiel in the Github Discussions about Beta testing. - Many thanks, Castiel
